source_versions.service_requests_311: NYC 311 faded/after-repaving line markings since 2020 (150 rows, SODA paginated)
source_versions.school_zones: DOE school points: elementary/K-8 within 800 ft (not attendance-zone polygons)
source_versions.vision_zero_crashes: NYPD Motor Vehicle Collisions pedestrian injured/killed since 2020 (h9gi-nx95)

pilot_boundary: Lower Manhattan south of Canal Street
scoring_method: sklearn logistic ranker (priority); heuristic paint/311 score is the baseline
eval_split: GroupKFold by neighborhood_id (train/test NTAs are disjoint)
product_claim: City-actionable inspection list of Lower Manhattan intersection nodes (not crosswalk polygons) that look degraded or under-marked relative to Vision Zero crash and 311 complaint burden.
caveat: Not a crosswalk detector and not a pretty-paint ranking. Candidates are LION/fixture intersection nodes; leg_label is the node, not a painted crossing. 311 Line/Marking complaints mix lane lines with crosswalks. Crash labels are noisy / weakly supervised. Metrics use a spatial (neighborhood) split so train and test NTAs are disjoint. Small n: treat AUC as directional, not a production SLA.
